name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_queue_visible_session_requests
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::QueueVisibleSessionRequests queues visible selected session rows that do not match the selected profile player name.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43ec00 verifies the cached-browse-record early exit, LB_GETSELCOUNT into g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeVisibleSessionResultCount, the create-session flag gate, LB_GETSELITEMS with a 0x400-entry stack array, one 0x58-byte transient request object reused per row, LB_GETTEXT into offset 0x24, TruncateStringAtFirstSpace, strstr against m_selectedProfilePlayerName, and QueueSessionRequest through vtable offset 0x54.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_queue_visible_session_requests_smoke uses a real multi-select listbox and fake QueueSessionRequest slot to verify the early exits, selected-row count global, first-space truncation, selected-profile skip, and queued request copies.
